top_signals.title: BOJ Split Vote Sends Bearish Signal on Yen, Strategists Say
top_signals.summary: The yen dropped after the Bank of Japan’s decision to hike rates as a split vote sent bearish signals, strategists said. The Japanese currency fell as much as 0.5% after the central bank raised its benchmark interest rate by a quarter percentage point to 1.25%.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Central-bank repricing affecting yields, FX, liquidity and equities.

top_signals.title: Bank of Japan raises rates to highest since 1995
top_signals.summary: Central bank cites inflation risks as it lifts interest rates by 0.25 percentage points to 1.25%
top_signals.why_it_matters: Central-bank repricing affecting yields, FX, liquidity and equities.

top_signals.title: Trump’s pressure on NATO is reshaping Europe’s defenses. Will it break the alliance?
top_signals.summary: At least eight member countries are beginning to diversify away from their reliance on U.S. weapons, technology and defense companies.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.
